name: vnpay-platform-mode-resolution
title: Sửa ghép sai mode và credential VNPAY
description: Đảm bảo credential nền tảng sandbox không bị dùng với cổng VNPAY production và mọi payment session tạo URL theo mode credential thực tế.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Platform credentials now carry an explicit real mode (sandbox by default). Shared provider URL creation prefers PaymentSession.providerCredentialMode, so stale restaurant production settings cannot combine sandbox TmnCode/Hash Secret with the production gateway. Focused tests were added but not executed because the connector has no checkout/dependencies; no workflow run was created.
